$comment: Machine-readable product terminology. Only English and Simplified Chinese are controlled here; other locales translate from these. Rationale lives in the private terminology spec and term cards. Statuses: decided terms block new UI copy (severity error); open terms only warn until a decision is made.

terms.meaning: Primary reading unit; imported, authored, extracted, or AI-derived.
Upstream, more complete topic such as an imported article.
Topic produced from a highlight, excerpt, cloze, split, or AI rewrite.
Selected text range or the act of marking it.
Text extracted from a topic; may become a derived topic.
Excerpt of any rectangular PDF page region; not a screenshot or OCR.
Creating an item by hiding part of a text.
Creating source topics from outside material.
Question, cloze, or front/back item that is reviewed; never a generic folder member.
Today's work view; not a container.
Aggregate view of every topic; not a container.
Reading flow; Chinese wording not recorded here yet.
In use in UI; not yet in the terminology table.
In use in UI; conflicts with the rejected word Entry until decided.

avoid.reason: Internal tree structure; name the actual objects (topics, folders, items) instead.
Engineering word, yet current settings UI uses it (Node review settings); decide before blocking.
Foliole is not a note app; allowed only for external sources (Obsidian notes) or a user-typed note field.
Anki wording for Item; allowed for imported Anki/SuperMemo decks until decided.
Rejected as an umbrella word, but UI uses it widely (batch actions, Virtual entry); decide before blocking.
Only for import sources or external formats, not as a Foliole object.
